ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: I picked Plover because the request—drafting a structured job description—is a benign professional writing task, and Plover scores meaningfully higher on the relevant dimensions: Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8) and Extraction/synthesis, plus stronger instruction-following on multi-part outputs (its IFEval and Arena-Hard scores are notably above Whimbrel's). The safety/moderation specialization that distinguishes the two models is irrelevant here since there's no harm-adjacent content, so I defaulted to raw capability, where Plover is the better fit.
